summary: Reviewed 16 units. Total issues: 8 error, 34 minor (34 carry a machine patch). Errors: unit 1 sota split invents ta (sa+uta); unit 4 invents "went" for atṛṇat and misplaces abhi; unit 5 carataḥ labelled nom. du. and vayunā labelled instrumental (yā vayunā are n. pl.); unit 7 ṣo split su+u is impossible; unit 9 placeholder text_flags; unit 12 English drops the negation (cana: not even the waters). Recurring minor: ṛta rendered truth instead of order (units 7, 8), brahman as sacred word (3, 15), maghavan as bounteous (12), refrain at/in the rite (16), Hindi-English mismatches (2, 8, 10). No text_flags needed (printed lines show no clear typos). Glossary proposals: see final report. No regrouping suggested.
